methodology: Math policy, dtype, requested/realized algorithm, schedule, numerical and ranking contracts are separate group keys.

All seven samples, measured replay counts, calibration, cold times, compiler/stage receipts and failure diagnostics are preserved.
Failed, unsupported, incomplete or invalid-evidence pairs receive no ratio. No oracle or acceptance bound is changed.
Native and Torch allocation/compilation boundaries differ; host submission gaps may appear inside event spans.
Common-envelope acceptance does not prove identical SDPA arithmetic. Secondary strict errors remain visible.
UTF-8 LF output; public path labels normalized, raw content receipts retained; no PATH or GPU UUID.
